note.en: A small rocky-shore top snail recorded north of Puerto Limón in 1992 and in a Limón museum lot. Only a regional record.
note.es: Un caracol trompo pequeño de orilla rocosa registrado al norte de Puerto Limón en 1992 y en un lote de museo de Limón. Es solo un registro regional.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)
